Fuel.note: The ONE Nuclear press release filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission in October 2025 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1846416/000149315225019001/ex99-1.htm) describes gas generation at its first two sites, one in Oklahoma. The company's plan is gas first, with nuclear later. So the fuel is gas, not nuclear.

Equipment Manufacturer/Model.note: The same filing says ONE Nuclear has a non-binding relationship with Rolls-Royce Solutions America for gas generators. This implies but does not prove the engines at this site.

units.notes: I found no address, county, permit or queue entry for this site. The filing only says Oklahoma. The 2028 date is a company goal, and GEM already shows 2028.

qa.question: Where is the ONE Nuclear Oklahoma gas site?
qa.finding: The filing at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1846416/000149315225019001/ex99-1.htm names Oklahoma only. No ODEQ permit, commission cause or queue entry matched, and the point GEM shows could not be checked.
qa.recommendation: Leave the point and the blank city as they are. Search again when ONE Nuclear files an air permit or names a county.
qa.note: The location ladder found no address, so no imagery was checked.
